James and his team of tasters visited the cellars of Spain’s famous winery Muga this June and checked out the bodega with Eduardo Muga, one of the owners. Not only were the winemaking facilities and cellars impressive, the wines were equally eye-opening, even with some grilled lamb chops at the end.
